> Regarding Thoughts Betrayed...just double-checking to make sure...

> Can both Mariel, Lady Thunder and Elysium: the Arboretum be tapped in
> response to TB? They both say to tap before range is determined...I
> suppose since TB is before combat, they can, but I want to make sure.

Mariel/Elysium may be used after TB has been played, yes.
TB is "as combat is entered", not before combat (errata).

What is this, and how can I get on it?

Ian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It's a mailing list for VTES-related discussions. To subscribe,
send e-mail to list...@oracle.wizards.com and put the command

SUBSCRIBE VTES-L FirstName LastName

in the body of the message (without any non-command lines, like
a signature, to confuse the listserver).
